capabilities: Prompt for a template when creating a new note
Automatically apply a template when only one exists
Resolve the most specific folder path for template assignment
Disable the template prompt for folder-only usage
extras: The README warns it probably won't work well with other plugins such as Templater or daily notes, and it requires the core Templates plugin to be enabled with a templates folder assigned.
intentEvidence: It depends on the core Templates plugin to be enabled, and that a a templates folder is assigned.
motivation: The author found manually triggering a template whenever creating a note cumbersome, especially on mobile, and wanted the prompt to happen automatically.
problem: Obsidian requires manually triggering a template after creating a note, which is cumbersome, especially on mobile.

relations.evidence: It probably won't work well with other plugins eg Templater or daily notes.

summary: Automatically applies or prompts for a template when a new note is created, with per-folder template assignments.
